{{recipe}}

'''Koshary''', alternately spelled '''koshari''' or '''kushari''', is an Egyptian dish of rice, pasta, and legumes. It combines elements of both Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisines. According to Wikipedia it is Egypt's national dish and a widely popular street food.

== Ingredients ==

=== Base ===

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Basmati rice|basmati rice]]
* 1 cup brown [[Cookbook:Lentil|lentils]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Macaroni|elbow macaroni]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chickpea|chickpeas]]

=== Sauce ===

* ½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] canned [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* 1 cup water
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* 1 teaspoon ground black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]], more to taste
* 1 teaspoon white [[Cookbook:Wine vinegar|wine vinegar]], more to taste

== Procedure ==

=== Base ===

# If using dried chickpeas and lentils, soak them in water overnight.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the rice, chickpeas, and lentils until tender. Cook the macaroni until [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]]. Drain all.
# In a sealable container (e.g. a tupperware), layer the rice, the lentils, and the macaroni, and then the chickpeas. This is the koshari base.

=== Sauce ===

# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] the diced onions in olive oil until crisp. Drain off the excess oil if desired, and reserve for garnish.
# Mix the tomato paste and water in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Put on medium high heat, and stir in the cumin, black pepper and vinegar.
# Heat the sauce until most of the liquid evaporates.
# Add warm or hot water, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] it on low heat. Using a hand [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] to increase consistency is optional.

=== Serving ===

# Scoop 1½ cups of the koshari base into an individual bowl.
# Pour some sauce over the serving.
# [[Cookbook:Garnish|Garnish]] with 1 tablespoon of the onions.
# Add vinegar and black pepper to taste, and serve.
